questions: what does the warranty cover?
replies:
The warranty on your furniture covers defects in materials and workmanship under the manufacturer’s limited warranty, but this does not include damage from normal wear, misuse, or accidents. Coverage details vary by brand and product.

For accidental damage, you can add an optional five-year extended protection plan, which covers stains, tears, burns, cracks, and mechanical issues on reclining furniture. Floor model items are sold as-is and are not eligible for warranty or protection plan coverage.

For full details, see our [Warranty Information page](https://southjacksonfurniture.com/warranty-information). If you have questions about eligibility or filing a claim, contact us at:

Phone: [phone]
Email: [email]
